tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Price comparison for the German market (EUR): today's best prices for Pools from many shops (incl. Amazon and eBay) on wopool.de. USE WHEN the user asks for a price, a deal, "cheapest", "where to buy" or a specific product of this category (Pool). PARAMETERS: "query" = model, brand or feature; optio

tools.name: find_pages
tools.description: Finds the pages on wopool.de that answer a question about Pools: comparison pages with current prices (by feature or price range), buying guides and brand pages – each with title, summary and link. USE WHEN the user wants advice rather than one price: "which Pool should I buy", "what to look for", "

tools.name: lookup_product
tools.description: Returns the current price and links of ONE partner offer that search_offers returned before. USE WHEN you need to re-check the price of an offer from an earlier search_offers result. Do not use it to search – use search_offers. PARAMETERS: "id" = externalId from search_offers, or "url" = the product

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_offers, find_pages, lookup_product · Public sink: search_offers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_offers, find_pages, lookup_product · Public sink: search_offers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
